    • Coordination with Sales/Sales Ops on PQL definition and handoff.

    • Iterate with Pricing & Packaging team on P&P strategy and optoimization

  • Metrics ownership: define and report on leading indicators (platform usage, feature adoption, cross-sell conversion, open-source adoption), and rigorously attribute product usage and these metrics to business outcomes (pipeline, revenue, retention) not just track activity, but prove and quantify its impact.

Qualities we look for

  • A builder, first and foremost someone who can build with AI, prototype fast, test with real users, and scale what works. This is a hands-on role, not a strategy-only one.

  • Track record building or scaling a PLG motion that feeds a sales organization ideally with direct experience owning PQL definition and handoff.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management this role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering, and needs to align each of them without owning their roadmaps.

  • Experience growing adoption within a core consumer/prosumer product (web, extension, or app), not just developer-facing surfaces.

  • Experience designing growth loops for feature/product discovery and expansion, not just top-of-funnel acquisition.

  • Experience with open-source community strategy has shipped or grown an OSS project, ideally in ML/AI.

  • Comfortable working in a hybrid PLG + SLG model and operating cross-functionally with teams whose roadmaps this role doesn't own.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: CRO Strategist
description:
We need someone to own a portfolio of up to six brands end to end.

Find the test in the data and in what customers actually say, build the first version yourself, launch it, read the result, and tell the client what it means.

Tasks

One sentence: own the test loop end to end, from the research to the client.

  • Own CRO strategy and delivery for up to 6 brands, from the research through to the result.
  • Dig through the store data to find where each funnel is losing money.
  • Study competitors for offers, pages and mechanics worth testing.
  • Ship the first draft of the work, wether it's a full landing page or a copy test on an existing page hand it to our designer to polish and our developer to build.
  • Write the tasks our developers and designers build from clear enough that nobody has to guess what you meant.
  • Be the main point of contact for your clients. You are the person they talk to, not a layer between them and someone else.
  • Launch the tests, read the results, and tell the client what you ran, what it did, and what happens next.

Requirements

1-2 years of experience as a CRO strategist in a brand or agency.

Who You Are. Experience and background matter less than the following traits.

Bias to Action

You solve problems and move forward. You do not wait for permission, and you do not write a document about the problem instead of fixing it.

Makes the Team Win

We work as a team and win as a team. You make the people around you better on purpose, and you make the developer's and the designer's job easier without being asked. The result that counts is the one the team got to, not the one you got to alone.

Explains It So Anyone Gets It

You can explain the same test to a client or a team member, and both should come away able to act on it. And when you learn something that works, your instinct is to hand it to the team rather than keep it as your own edge.

Transparent to a Fault

A bad number gets flagged the same day. Silence is a dealbreaker.

Takes Feedback and Changes

Disagreeing with us and bringing data is necessary. Agreeing and then repeating the same thing is not.

Ownership

When something goes wrong, your instinct is to say what you should have caught, not who else caused it.

Obsessive Learner

You follow this industry because you find it genuinely interesting, and you show up with things we had not seen.

Already Works with AI

AI is already in your daily workflow, not something you have read about. It is not optional here, it is how we work.

Eye for Design

You are not a designer and we are not asking you to be, we have designers for that. But you have to be able to tell when something looks wrong.

Scientific and Pragmatic

You judge on revenue per visitor, not conversion rate. When a test is flat, you say it is flat. But you know when the certainty is good enough to move, because we would rather iterate than sit on a test chasing a number that will not change the decision.

Owns the Client Relationship

You are the main point of contact. You explain a test and a result in plain language, framed around the client's business. Clients are not an obstacle between you and the work.

Please Do NOT Apply If

  • You do not want to work with AI, it is how we work here.
  • You want to be the only person who knows how something works. We share what we learn here.
  • You want to write a lot of reports and stay in a CRO silo.
  • You want a calm, unchanging seat, because we move fast and we adapt our plans fast when the data says so.
  • If you want fast growth, learn a ton and you want to touch everything, work with us.

Benefits

Why Work Here

You Own the Whole Loop

Find it, build it, launch it, read it, explain it. Not a slice of someone else's process.

Personal AI Training from the Founder

Most of our production work, drafting pages, briefing developers, preparing client updates, runs through tooling we've built over the last eight months.

We will train you on it, so you ship ideas faster than you can anywhere else. Education budget is effectively unlimited.

Nobody Is Measured on Reports

Nobody here is measured on how much they documented. You are measured on the problems you solve and extra profit you generated.

Real Brands, Real Budgets

Between $10M and nine figures a year. Direct response, so the result shows up in the numbers within weeks.

Fully Remote

Work from anywhere with a minimum 5 hours overlap with Central European Time.

Salary

$45,000 to $65,000 USD per year, depending on experience and location. Contractor, starting with a paid trial period.

title: Engineering Supervisor /  Safety Technology Implementation Lead
description:
Are you an experienced railway professional with knowledge and experience of roles like COSS, ES and PICOP?

You already understand the track and the people who work on it. We're looking for people like you to help put new safety technology into the hands of the workforce - and to be part of a big change in how track workers are kept safe.

At Tended, we create first-of-a-kind safety systems that transform rail worker safety. Our geofencing solution has been named one of TIME's Best Inventions and has made the Digital Leaders 100 list for Geospatial Initiative of the Year. It's already out there on the track, helping to keep people away from the running line and improving on site efficiency.

Network Rail is committed to geofencing for the long term, and the rollout across the Sussex region is already underway. We're looking for an Implementation Lead to help us grow our capability on the ground.

Tasks

As an Implementation Lead, you're the bridge between Tended and our clients, guiding their teams through helping their teams get comfortable using our kit out on-site.

You'll lead key client deployments on the ground, working closely with Tended's project managers to deliver an excellent service. Success in this role depends on building strong, trusting relationships quickly - so first-class communication and interpersonal skills are essential.

Our technology is used by track workers with a wide range of technical confidence. You'll develop a deep understanding of our products so you can coach users through their day-to-day challenges and until they’re confident using it on their own. Being on-site also puts you in a unique position to see how our products are really used - spotting ideas for how we can make it better and feeding improvements back to the team.

You'll need strong knowledge of the rail environment and the roles within it, and you'll either hold a Personal Track Safety (PTS) qualification or meet the requirements to obtain one. Above all, we're looking for someone proactive and approachable - person fit matters to us.**

Travel and working pattern

This is a field-based role centred on regular client site visits across the Sussex region. You'll spend at least 3 days a week in the depot and on site, with the remaining time working remotely or in person with your line manager.

Because our users work shifts, this role covers both nightshifts and dayshifts, and includes weekend and bank holiday working - flexibility to meet the needs of the business and our clients is essential.

In return, we have excellent policies covering travel, accommodation and subsistence expenses, as well as fatigue management and time off in lieu.

A full driving licence is required.

Requirements

Even if you don’t feel you have all of the requirements listed below, we’d encourage you to apply, as we’re looking for someone who is willing to learn and grow with us.

  • You have experience as an ES, ESA, COSS, Site Agent, or in a comparable on-site leadership role within the railway or a related industry.

Desirable

description:

Despite working primarily in the backend and on the infrastructure that underpins it, the shopper and retailer experience will never be far from your mind, as delivering a great platform means:

  • product engineers can deliver quality, scalable solutions

  • shoppers have responsive, personalised in-store experiences

  • The security of the product

    • Authorisation covers RBAC and ReBAC

  • Developing and maintaining reliable and consistent automated release cycles

  • Managing cloud environments that support prototyping features that involve changes to our Android or web applications alongside changes to one or more of our backend microservices

  • Gatekeeping the quality of our APIs, webhooks and event-driven architecture in an open contributor model

  • Continually improving our internal agentic harnesses (e.g. skills and context) that allow other engineers and less technical colleagues to develop and prototype on our platform

  • Adding agentic automation to all appropriate areas of platform stack without compromising on quality

 

About You

Must Have

  • Distributed systems experience. You've designed or meaningfully contributed to distributed backend systems, and understand event-driven patterns, asynchronous messaging, and the trade-offs at scale.

  • API design and evolution. You've designed APIs that other teams and clients depend on, and you understand the trade-offs between clean design, backwards compatibility, and speed.

  • Database and schema fluency. Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimisation. Working knowledge of at least one non-relational store.

  • Real-time data. Experience processing or analysing real-time data streams at scale.

  • Cloud infrastructure. Experience deploying and operating distributed services on AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Shipping complex, customer-facing products at pace. Evidence that you can move real software into production quickly, making pragmatic decisions without letting perfection become a blocker.

  • Growth and ambition. A career that has moved fast, where you've taken on more scope sooner than the timeline would suggest.

  • AI-native engineering. You've shipped production code with frontier AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and push further into agentic workflows rather than push back on them.

 

Nice to Have (or We Can Teach)

  • Containers and orchestration. Docker and Kubernetes in production.

  • Retail or personalisation. Familiarity with retail technology, commerce platforms, or customer personalisation systems.

  • Startup experience. Background working at an early-stage startup.

 

How We Work

We are building a category-defining company. That requires ambition, intensity, high standards and a team that enjoys solving difficult problems together.

The people who thrive here are curious, proactive and energised by building. They enjoy experimenting, making decisions and turning ideas into products that people can use.

We draw energy from working together, so this is primarily an office-based role. Our office overlooks one of central London’s best garden squares and is a few minutes from Tottenham Court Road.

 

What We Offer

  • Direct access to our founders and a real voice in the calls that shape the product and the company.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Team offsites.

  • Cycle to work scheme

title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Design System
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Design System team, you'll be a co-owner of the shared UI foundation that every Synthesia product is built on. You will be shaping direction and making key decisions together with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role: your primary output is high-quality component code and the tooling around it.

The defining challenge of this role is making that foundation AI-friendly: a design system that both people and AI can build with. As AI tools generate more of our UI, the system has to make it effortless to produce interfaces that are on-brand, accessible and correct by construction, whether the author is a human or an agent.

You can expect to:

  • Build, scale and evolve our design system: the component library, design tokens, and documentation that give product teams a consistent, accessible foundation to build on.

  • Extend our design system for AI-assisted development so AI coding tools and agents can use our components, tokens and guidelines as easily as people can, with Storybook as the backbone and machine-readable interfaces (e.g. MCP) layered on top.

  • Design component APIs that resist misuse, so AI and human developers alike can build with confidence.

  • Write high-quality, performant frontend code (React/TypeScript) and raise the bar for component craft and consistency across the engineering org.

  • Partner closely with design, product and engineering to define components together and take them all the way to something that holds up in production.

  • Make our components accessible by default, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA, and work closely with our Accessibility engineer to bake in best practices from the start.

  • Own the developer experience of the design system: clear documentation, guidelines, Storybook, sensible component APIs, versioning and smooth migration paths that make adoption easy for both human and AI consumers.

  • Implement and maintain theming, white labelling, and localization/RTL support so the system works for a global audience.

  • Continuously improve the system based on adoption metrics, contributor feedback and new platform capabilities.

  • Shape the technical direction of the design system over the next 6–12 months, championing its adoption across teams.

 

What we're looking for

  • At least five (5) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building frontend platforms, with real ownership of a design system or shared component library used across multiple products.

  • Deep frontend expertise: expert HTML, CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript, with strong React and familiarity with modern build tooling.

  • A strong command of component API design, versioning and the developer experience of shared libraries.

  • Experience (or strong interest) in making component libraries consumable by AI

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance.

  • Comfortable building components to WCAG 2.2 AA / EN 301 549 and verifying them yourself with a keyboard and screen reader — accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the ability to balance design intent with engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, and a passion for improving developer productivity and end-user experience.

Nice to haves

  • A strong design sensibility — an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them.

  • Experience implementing multi-brand theming in production.

  • Experience with localization and internationalization (including RTL) for a global audience.

 

Why join us?

We're living the golden age of AI. The next decade will yield the next iconic companies, and we dare to say we have what it takes to become one. Here's why,

 

Our culture

At Synthesia we're passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Serving 50,000+ customers (and 90% of the Fortune 500)

We're trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald's and more. Read stories from happy customers and what 1,200+ people say on G2.

 

Proprietary AI technology

Since 2017, we've been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Our AI technology is built in-house, by a team of world-class AI researchers and engineers. Learn more about our AI Research Lab and the team behind.

 

AI Safety, Ethics and Security

AI safety, ethics, and security are fundamental to our mission. While the full scope of Artificial Intelligence's impact on our society is still unfolding, our position is clear: People first. Always. Learn more about our commitments to AI Ethics, Safety & Security.

The hiring process:

  1. 30 min call with our Technical Recruiter

  2. 45min call with an Engineering Manager about your past projects

  3. 75min Live Coding interview, a collaboration exercise with our Engineer (not Leetcode style, focus more on good frontend engineering practices)

  4. 60min System Design, technical discussion usually about a real problem we had in production (the call will also include our Designer so expect more design system focused discussion)

  5. 60min call with leadership, focus on examples of collaboration, growth and going through details of your future team

You can find more details on what to expect and how to prepare HERE. The process does not need to take long - we can be done in seven working days.
